liturgicalName: 34th Sunday: Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe
keyVerseDR: "...For this was I born, and for this came I into the world; that I should give testimony to the truth..." (Jn 18:37)

level1.title: Jesus Is King
level1.story: Pilate asked Jesus, "Are You a king?" Jesus said, "My Kingdom is not from this world." Jesus is the King of truth and love!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How do you follow King Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, my King, I love You. Amen.

activity.title: Christ the King
activity.intro: Connect the dots to make the King's crown.

level2.title: My Kingdom Is Not of This World
level2.story: Pilate asked Jesus, "Art Thou the king of the Jews?" Jesus answered, "My kingdom is not of this world." Pilate said, "Art Thou a king then?" Jesus said, "Thou sayest that I am a king. For this was I born, and for this came I into the world; that I should give testimony to the truth." Jesus said, "Every one that is of the truth, heareth My voice."
level2.keyLine: For this was I born, that I should give testimony to the truth.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is Jesus' kingdom different from earthly kingdoms?
How can you listen to the King's voice?
actions: Make Jesus King of my day
level2.prayer: Christ the King, reign in my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus answers Pilate
activity.intro: Number the word cards in order.

art.mainBrief: Jesus before Pilate, calm, with a crown of truth
